capture.description: Stay warm from the ground up with the Indera Men’s Heavyweight Cotton Waffle Long Johns Thermal Underwear Bottom. Made from 100% cotton waffle knit fabric, these classic thermal bottoms are designed to trap and retain body heat, keeping you warm in very cold conditions. The heavyweight waffle weave balances insulation with breathability for lasting comfort whether you’re working outside, layering for winter sports, or relaxing at home. Soft cotton construction feels comfortable against the skin, while rib-knit ankle cuffs help seal in warmth and stay secure under boots or outerwear. Built with durable stitching and a tagless label to reduce irritation, these thermal bottoms are made for long-lasting wear. Available in both Regular and Tall sizes, they are an essential base layer for work, outdoor adventures, or casual cold-weather comfort—also making them a practical winter gift.
